projectState.summary: The repo has a Studio Pattern scaffold, GitHub setup notes, and an initial plan for a browser-first local Ollama-powered musical terrarium. Claude's first review was ingested. Current first implementation slice is a rule-based PixiJS/Tone.js terrarium with three musical players. The time model is delayed-now/lookahead, and the session model explicitly supports breaks, solo practice, rehearsal, performance, reflection, constructed pieces, and meaningful silence.
